description: The team's skills. action 'list' (query?) lists them; 'get' (skill, version?, part?: 'all' | 'instructions' | 'spec') reads one, its instructions, procedures, traps and environment, so you do not have to discover the application again. 'save' keeps what you learned: skillMd (a whole SKILL.md) or name + description (what it does and when to use it) + instructions (Markdown), and spec (capsulate/skill.json: environment, frames, inputs, procedures as run_actions steps with {{param}} placeholders, checks, traps) and files. It creates the skill, or adds a proposed version when the team has one by that name; what a new version leaves out is kept. 'versions' (skill) lists versions; 'approve' (skill, version, force?) makes one current (a passing rehearsal, or force); 'reject' and 'rollback' (skill, version); 'archive' and 'unarchive' (skill). 'environment' (skill, sessionId, setup?) saves the capsule as the skill's environment once the software is installed and set up: a saved template, and a version that launches from it (capsulate_launch with skill), its setup procedure run after each launch. 'rehearse' (skill, version, sessionId?, keep?) proves a version before it is approved: a fresh capsule from its environment (or the capsule given), its fingerprint and checks; follow it with capsulate_skill_run get. 'weekly' (skill, on) rehearses the current version every week to notice when the software changes.

description.description: For save: what the skill does and when to use it (at most 1024 characters)

files.description: For save: other files of the skill folder

path.description: Relative path in the skill folder, e.g. scripts/plan.py or references/menus.md

force.description: For save as current, or approve: skip the rehearsal (the owner's call)

instructions.description: For save: the SKILL.md body in Markdown

keep.description: For rehearse: keep the fresh capsule after the rehearsal

lessonId.description: For save: the lesson this skill was learned from

name.description: For save: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. krita-painting

note.description: For save or approve: what changed, or why

on.description: For weekly: turn the weekly rehearsal on or off

part.description: For get: everything (default), only the SKILL.md, or only the spec (the procedures' steps)

query.description: For list: words to match in the name or description

sessionId.description: For environment: the capsule to save as the skill's environment

setup.description: For environment: the procedure a launch runs once the capsule is ACTIVE

skillMd.description: For save: the whole SKILL.md (frontmatter with name and description, then instructions)

spec.description: For save: capsulate/skill.json {kind?, apps?, environment?, frames?, inputs?, procedures?, checks?, traps?}

state.description: For save: the new version's state

name: capsulate_skills
title: Skills: what was learned before, and what you learned
